items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 20 at 2:22AM EDT until October 21 at 9:00PM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and seas
3 to 6 ft.

* WHERE...Edisto Beach to Savannah out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM EDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
